posts.title: Floral indigo dress
posts.description: A few years ago, I sewed a cat print Indigo dress. It’s a favourite, and I wear it often. It’s comfortable and cute and I love it, but weirdly, I only sewed that pattern once. This summer, I wanted a new dress for an occasion, so I made myself a new Indigo. I got this pretty rayon from Sewcialising when I worked there during my career break. posts.title: Short circular needles
posts.description: I’m a new convert to short circular needles for knitting sleeves. posts.title: Equilibrium
posts.description: The word I chose to represent how I live this year was “equilibrium”. At the back end of last year, I found myself continually pushing too hard on individual projects, to the detriment of all else (hello monotropism).
